author: THSV StreamBridge
description: A built-in wellness timer that plans breaks from your planned stream length, warns you before each one, and switches only to scenes found in your connected streaming app.
changelog: 4.1.8: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.8, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.0.10: hardens automatic breaks with safe return-scene capture, early-BRB cancellation, terminal ending-scene handling, integer-safe scheduling, and non-blocking timer callbacks.

manifest.name: Stream Break & End Guard
installationSteps: Enable this built-in extension and choose the broadcast app, break scene, break interval, break length, maximum stream length, and ending scene.
Import the bundled Stream Break & End Guard Streamer.bot helper and approve only its triggerless Scene Controller action.
Refresh the scene catalogue and select exact detected scene names in the wizard instead of copying and pasting them.
Add the extension overlay URL to the scenes where the five-minute warning should be visible.
Run an offline overlay preview, then verify one short private test stream before relying on automatic scene changes.
uninstallationSteps: Disable the extension. Its small schedule history is kept on this computer unless you delete the extension data.

healthChecks.description: Checks that live timing is saved, warnings stay within limits, and scene switches happen only when safe.
